title: Annual Paint the Town Success
paragraphs: Enjoying the New Saquatucket Municipal Marina

The Guild of Harwich Artists gathered at Saquatucket Municipal Marina in Harwich Port last Saturday as part of their annual ‘Paint the Town.’ On a sunny June day, Guild artists, painting en plein air, spread out along the newly constructed harbormaster complex and Dockside Seafood Shack overlooking the boat-filled marina. Starting early in the morning and running through mid-afternoon, about a dozen artists captured the moods in the changing tide and light.
‘Paint the Town’ is part of the 85-member Guild’s on-going commitment to bring art to the community. In recent years the event has been held at Harwich Center, Harwich Port and Wychmere Harbor.
Visit the Guild’s Gallery located at 551 MA-28, Harwich Port, MA 02646 to view some of paintings produced during the day. For more information, visit www.guildofharwichartists.org.
